messages:
maria: FYI I ran a head-to-head across L4 / T4 / A10G for two workloads: embeddings (embed-small-v2) and a small-chat 7B variant. Wanted quick notes + numbers before we decide region placement and kernel defaults.

jon: nice — which regions?

maria: us-west1, eu-west1, asia-east1. single-instance throughput then scaled to 1k qps estimates. quant stacks: fp16 baseline + PTQ-4 + int8 for T4 where supported. kernels: default cuDNN path, flash-attn where available, and triton fused matmuls on A10G.

benchbot: auto-run summary (condensed):
```
EMBEDDINGS (embed-small-v2, seq=256)
- L4 (fp16): p50=18ms, p95=44ms, tok/s=850, req/s(batch=8)=106, cost/1k reqs~= $0.09
- T4 (fp16): p50=22ms, p95=60ms, tok/s=720, req/s(batch=8)=90, cost/1k reqs~= $0.06
- A10G (fp16): p50=11ms, p95=28ms, tok/s=1600, req/s(batch=16)=200, cost/1k reqs~= $0.12
PTQ-4 on T4: +1.5x tok/s, p95 down ~20% but small quality delta measured (cosine delta ~0.004 avg)

SMALL-CHAT (7B-ish, context=512)
- L4 (fp16): p50=85ms, p95=210ms, tok/s=240, requests/s(interactive batch=1)=8, cost/1k msgs~= $1.8
- T4 (fp16): p50=110ms, p95=320ms, tok/s=190, req/s=7, cost/1k msgs~= $1.1
- A10G (fp16): p50=45ms, p95=120ms, tok/s=520, req/s=18, cost/1k msgs~= $2.6
PTQ-4 on L4/A10G: ~1.6x throughput, but on small-chat we saw a measurable quality regression on targeted QAs (see below)
```

anya: those cost numbers assume on-demand pricing right? pricing model for Dedicated will change effective cost per token.

maria: yes on-demand. For Dedicated we can conservatively divide by 2.5x depending on commit. The thing that surprised me: T4 is cheapest for embeddings by cost/unit (good memory density), but it consistently trails in p95 on chat in eu-west1 — likely PCIe/host-networking backpressure for long contexts.

sam: any kernel surprises?

maria: A10G + triton fused matmuls + flash-attn gave the best story for chat latency and tail. L4 benefits from larger SM count for embeddings when we enable continuous batching/prfx cache. T4 performed best when we force smaller working set and use PTQ-4; int8 boost was situational.

benchbot: quality check (small-chat) after PTQ-4:
```
- QA benchmark (200 prompts): baseline fp16 exact-match=0.62
- T4 PTQ-4 exact-match=0.58 (drop 6.5%)
- A10G PTQ-4 exact-match=0.60 (drop 3.2%)
- Embedding cosine drift avg: 0.0035 (negligible)
```

jon: important — embeddings safe, chat needs manual eval sets + eval alerts. any region divergence?

maria: yes — eu-west1 T4 p95 skewed badly under mixed traffic (emb+chat). us-west1 was stable. asia-east1 had slightly higher p50 on A10G due to kernel availability differences (we fallback to cuda kernels; flash-attn build lag in that region).

anya: what do you recommend for placement rules?

maria: short: embeddings -> prefer T4 in us-west1/eu-west1 for cost unless you need very low tail; then A10G. Chat (low-latency small-chat) -> A10G in us-west1 (or dedicated L4 pools if committed). For mixed workloads, use routing: embeddings->T4, chat->A10G, fallback to compressed variants. Also enable PTQ-4 for embeddings by default, but gate PTQ for chat behind eval; roll it using canary with quality checks.

sam: sizing note: rough capacity per card for 1k steady qps (embed-small): T4 ~14 cards, L4 ~8 cards, A10G ~6 cards. For small-chat interactive at 1k qps (single-turn messages): A10G ~55 cards, L4 ~110 cards, T4 not recommended at large scale unless heavily quantized and batched. Those are ballpark.

jon: anything about p99/tail mitigation?

maria: enable prefix/KV caching for chat, limit maximum batching latency (SLO 50ms), enable smart routing to avoid cross-region fallbacks, and prefer kernels with lower host-sync (triton/flash where available). Also throttle large batch bursts and set backpressure on request spikes.

benchbot: logs snippet from eu-west1 T4 run showing backpressure spikes:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] queue_delay=128ms host_mem_pressure=high p95=360ms
[2026-03-15T10:12:04Z] retry_policy=spare_fallback -> routed to A10G
```

anya: good call on canaries. can we add an automatic small-chat quality eval to rollout pipelines for PTQ-4?

maria: yes I wired a quick eval harness. It runs 500 promprompt pairs and fails rollout if exact-match drops >2% or if p95 increases >25%. I'll open a PR to plug into rollout.

sam: awesome. thanks for the numbers — this helps for the Dedicated sizing doc.

maria: leaving raw csv + perf graphs here: https://internal/bucket/bench/1795564321/graphs.zip (contains per-region histograms + kernel flags used). I'll follow up with a tiny PR to default embeddings->PTQ-4 on T4 and a canary gate for chat. :thumbsup:
